people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will Yahweh feed them like a lamb in a meadow.
translations.bsb: For Israel is as obstinate as a stubborn heifer. Can the LORD now shepherd them like lambs in an open meadow?
translations.kjv: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
translations.asv: For Israel hath behaved himself stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer: now will Jehovah feed them as a lamb in a large place.
